notes: Captured from the live OONI aggregation API (api.ooni.io/api/v1/aggregation) with since=2026-11-04&until=2026-11-11&time_grain=day&axis_x=probe_cc&axis_y=measurement_start_day, one request per test name – exactly the requests the adapter makes at the fixture epoch. Each response keeps its envelope (v, dimension_count, db_stats) and is trimmed to a country sample: 86 countries for web_connectivity (including low-volume country-days below the 50-measurement threshold and a territory missing from the gazetteer, GP) and the same 36 countries for the six app tests. Values are untouched. 2026-11-10 was still in progress at capture time (17:51 UTC), so its counts are partial. The malformed variant of the web_connectivity route was authored by hand from the same schema.
